onboardingExample: For example: Read 20 pages of a book.
onboardingFirstDay: Today is a bonus opportunity. Skipping it won’t break your streak.
onboardingMinimum: Add at least one habit to start your journey.
intro: Start with one habit. Choose the pillars that matter to you and the days that fit your routine. You can add more later.
goal: What do you want to do?
goalHelp: Write a clear goal you can mark as done.
creationOptionalHelp: Today is optional. Skipping it won’t break your streak.
optionalHelp: Today is an optional first opportunity. Leaving it unchecked does not count as a missed goal.
saveError: Could not save. Your last saved state is unchanged.
goalError: Enter a goal and select at least one weekday.
emptyPillar: No habits yet. This pillar creates no obligations.
storageNote: Your records stay in this browser. Clearing browser data can remove them.
baseXpHelp: Each completion earns 10 base XP. Bonuses are extra.
streakHelp: A habit streak counts consecutive eligible completions, not calendar days. A pillar streak counts eligible days with every required goal done.
todayAllCompleted: Good job! All habits completed today.
dayMotto: Your day, one step at a time.
nextBonusOne: Next bonus: {bonus} in {remaining} more consecutive completion.
nextBonusMany: Next bonus: {bonus} in {remaining} more consecutive completions.
levelProgressText: {earned} of {required} XP toward the next level.
overallStreakHelp: The overall streak counts completed eligible days: every required habit across all pillars is done. Unscheduled days and unchecked optional first-day opportunities are neutral. An unfinished required day only breaks the streak after the local day closes.
journeyRewardHelp: Habit completions and their milestone bonuses earn XP. Pillar and daily streaks do not add extra XP. Correcting a completion recalculates XP, level, and streaks.
trailMapSummary: Levels {start} to {end}. Your position: Level {level}, {percent}% toward Level {next}.
dailyStreakHelp: Your daily streak counts consecutive eligible days when you complete all scheduled required habits across every pillar. Days without required habits are neutral.
dailyStreakOptionalHelp: A completed optional first-day opportunity can also make that day eligible.
dailyStreakTimingHelp: An unfinished current day stays pending until the local day ends. Your daily streak advances at most once per eligible day and adds no extra XP.
journeyProgressionParagraphs: Complete all required habits scheduled for a day, across all pillars, to increase your daily streak. It increases at most once per day.
Days with no required habits are neutral: they neither increase nor break your daily streak. Completing an optional habit on the day you create it can make that day count.
Today stays pending while required habits remain incomplete. If any are still incomplete when your local day ends, your daily streak breaks.
Habit completions earn XP, with bonus XP at habit streak milestones. Every 100 XP advances your level. Pillar and daily streaks do not award extra XP.
Checking or unchecking a completion recalculates XP, your level, and current and best streaks.
noActiveHabits: No active habits. Archived habits keep their history.
correctionHelp: This updates XP, level, and current and best streaks.
recordUpdated: Record updated. XP and streaks recalculated.
exemptHelp: This habit was archived that day, so it was no longer required.
effectiveHelp: Changes apply from {date}. Today’s goal and schedule stay unchanged.
moveCreditedHelp: Today's completion stays in {source}. This habit moves to {target} on {date}.
moveUndoneHelp: Today's goal stays in {source}. This habit moves to {target} on {date}.
movePreservedHelp: Today stays in {source}. This habit moves to {target} on {date}.
moveBeforeHelp: Complete this habit today to count in {target}. Otherwise, it moves on {date}.
archiveHelp: Takes effect now. History, XP and unlocked items are kept.
archiveUnfinished: Today's unfinished goal is no longer required. No XP is added.
futureDateHelp: Your device date is before this habit's start date. This view is read-only: there are no eligible history dates or goals to complete yet. Saved records are unchanged.
reactivateHelp: Starts a new habit streak. Your best, XP and items stay.
cancelResumptionHelp: This habit will stay archived. History, XP and items are kept.
unsavedChangesDescription: Your latest changes won’t be saved.
staleError: Your data changed in another tab. Reload and review before trying again.
historicalConflict: These dates already have saved history. Return to the current device date and review this habit before making changes. Your saved history is unchanged.
backupPrivacy: Contains your goals and history. Keep the file private.
downloadStarted: Download started. Keep the file safe.
replaceWarning: This replaces your current records, settings and owned items. Nothing is merged.
invalidBackup: Invalid or unsupported backup. Your current data is unchanged. Choose another backup.
backupTooLarge: This backup exceeds the supported 20 MiB limit. Your records are unchanged.
fileTooLarge: This file exceeds the supported 20 MiB limit. Your current data is unchanged. Choose another backup.
deleteQuestion: Delete all data in this browser?
deleteHelp: Habits, history, XP, owned items, settings and drafts will be removed. This cannot be undone without a backup.
deleteSeparate: This is different from archiving a habit.
progressIntro: Consistency, one day at a time.
noScheduledPeriod: No scheduled days in this period.
streakScopeNote: History through yesterday. Streaks include today.
habitNotScheduled: This habit was not scheduled on this day.
pillarNotScheduled: No habits were scheduled for this pillar on this day.
allNotScheduled: No habits were scheduled on this day.
beforeCreationDay: This date is before this habit was created. It is not a missed day.
archivedDay: This habit was archived on this date and had no requirement. It is not a missed day.
optionalDayNeutral: The optional first opportunity was not completed. It created no requirement.
openHabitHelp: Select a habit goal to manage it or correct eligible records.
managementArchiveHelp: Archiving removes the habit from your active routine. History and earned XP are preserved.
pillarOccupied: Move or archive the active habits before removing this pillar.
removePillarHelp: This removes the pillar from your active list. Habits, history and earned XP are preserved.
chooseActivePillar: Choose an active pillar before reactivating this habit.
noDestinationPillar: Create a pillar before reactivating this habit.
pillarRemoved: Pillar removed from the active list.
updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Try again when online.
updateCurrent: The app is up to date.
updateAwaitingSafe: An update is ready. It will apply at the next safe app opening. Close other app windows first.
updateOffline: You are offline. Connect to check for updates.
updateApplyFailed: The update could not finish. Your work is still here. Try again or reopen the app when it is safe.
